news.title: Two-Thirds of Americans Disapprove of Trump’s Handling of the Russia-Ukraine War
news.summary_en: Around four-in-ten Americans say Trump is favoring Russia too much in the conflict, while a much smaller share (7%) say he is favoring Ukraine too much.
